extDescription.message: Real-time synced lyrics beside the YouTube player, with karaoke-style word highlighting. Powered by LRCLIB.

notFound.message: No lyrics found. Press ⌕ to search manually

durationMismatch.message: These lyrics differ from the video by $SECONDS$s, so timing may be off. Press ⏱ and click the line being sung, or use ⌕ to pick another version.

syncTitle.message: Sync timing: click this, then click the line being sung right now. Shortcut: Alt+click (Option+click on Mac) a line.

syncPrompt.message: Click the line being sung right now. Press ⏱ again to cancel.

brokenSync.message: The synced timing for this song on LRCLIB is broken, so the lyrics are shown without sync. Use ⌕ to look for another version.
